## New
- Play on: move what you're watching or listening to onto another linked device, or control it from here, from the new devices button in the music player, the mini player and the video player; the sheet shows what plays where, with artwork, progress, controls and volume, and lists devices as playing, available or offline (#1412)
- Play on: the first time a device asks to play here, you choose Allow always, Allow once or Decline; change it later under Linked devices. Android TV receives handoffs and shows which device took over (#1412)
